format: lines: [quantity, unitPrice, tvaRate]; tvaLines: [rate, baseHT, tva]; totalTTC = totalHT + totalTVA (never the timbre); netAPayer = totalTTC + timbre; every number is a string with 3 decimals, as Postgres prints numeric. expected is either the totals or {"error":"MoneyRangeError"}, raised when netAPayer exceeds numeric(12,3). The oracle is private.compute_totals().

handWritten.comment: Line tie. 0.001 x 0.500 = 0.0005, exactly half a millime: half-up gives 0.001 (truncation would give 0.000).
Just under the tie. 0.001 x 0.499 = 0.000499, below half a millime: 0.000.
Half-up, not half-even. 1.5 x 0.001 = 0.0015 -> 0.002 and 2.5 x 0.001 = 0.0025 -> 0.003 (banker's rounding would give 0.002 twice). Base 0.005.
Quantity with 3 decimals, tie on the line. 1.333 x 7.500 = 9.9975 -> 9.998. TVA 19 % of 9.998 = 1.89962 -> 1.900. TTC 11.898.
TVA once per rate, not per line (option B). Three lines of 0.003 at 19 %: base 0.009, TVA = 0.00171 -> 0.002. Per line it would be 0.00057 -> 0.001 three times = 0.003.

Several rates given out of order, with a timbre. Bases: 0 % -> 10.000; 7 % -> 100.000 (TVA 7.000); 13 % -> 1.000 (TVA 0.130); 19 % -> 100.000 + 60.000 = 160.000 (TVA 30.400). HT 271.000, TVA 37.530, TTC 271.000 + 37.530 = 308.530 (never the timbre), net à payer 308.530 + 1.000 = 309.530. The table is sorted by rate.
TVA tie. 19 % of 0.050 = 0.0095, exactly half a millime: 0.010. TTC 0.060.
A rate with 3 decimals, TVA tie. 0.050 % of 1.000 = 0.0005 -> 0.001. TTC 1.001.
Zero price. Everything is 0, TTC included; only the net à payer carries the timbre: 1.000. The 19 % rate still appears in the table with a base of 0.
No lines, no timbre: every total is 0 and the TVA table is empty.
No lines, with a timbre: TTC is 0, the net à payer is the timbre alone.
The largest amount of numeric(12,3), exactly: 1 x 999999999.999 at 0 %. Still allowed.
One millime over the maximum, through the timbre: 999999999.999 + 0.001 = 1000000000.000.
Over the maximum on a single line: 2 x 999999999.999 = 1999999999.998.
quantity x price far above 2^53 (about 1e24 before scaling): the result is about 1e18 TND, over the maximum.
The highest rate, 100 %: TVA equals the base. 12.345 + 12.345 = 24.690.
